notes: Single-storey rendered-block roadhouse. It has a gable roof (ridge along x), a full-width front veranda on steel posts carrying the ROADHOUSE fascia sign, a cool room at the back +x end and a corrugated tank on a timber stand at the back -x end. The scale bar is about 42 px/m, which fits the Front and Right views: about 13.8 m wide, 8.5 m main block plus a 3.1 m veranda, ridge about 4.5 m. The sheet contradicts itself: the Left view omits the tank and cool room that the Right and Back views show behind the back wall, and the Top view draws them beside the -x wall with a compressed depth. I placed them per the Back and Right views.
